$comment: Format B (minimal schema, Plan P2.6): the four decision fields of Format A, in the same order and with the same descriptions. "x-cjp-enum" is replaced by the enum from taxonomy/labels.yaml when the schema is rendered (cjp/triage/schema.py). The descriptions are listed in the system prompt and left out of the schema sent.

technique_label.description: Exactly one value from the technique label list: a label, none, other or uncertain.

disposition.description: What should happen to this alert.

confidence.description: How strongly the evidence in this alert supports technique_label and disposition.

recommended_action.description: 1-2 sentences: the specific next step for the analyst, which fits the disposition.
